title: TravelIQ
description: Context-aware travel optimization framework combining crowd forecasting, weather modeling, and routing.
longDescription: A comprehensive travel optimization framework that integrates SARIMAX-based crowd forecasting, statistical weather suitability modeling, and vehicle-routing optimization for intelligent itinerary generation. The system builds predictive pipelines combining time-series forecasting, transformer-based sentiment analysis, and constraint-based scheduling methods to deliver personalized, data-driven travel recommendations.
highlights: SARIMAX-based crowd density forecasting for 20+ tourist locations
Transformer-based sentiment analysis using DistilBERT for real-time reviews
Constraint-based VRP optimization using Google OR-Tools
Weather suitability scoring using Open-Meteo API
End-to-end pipeline from data ingestion to itinerary output

title: Republic of Bean
description: AI-driven platform simulating parliamentary discussions and policy voting using autonomous agents.
longDescription: An interactive policy simulation platform built with Next.js and OpenAI API that simulates parliamentary discussions through autonomous AI agents. Each agent represents a political faction with distinct ideological profiles. The platform generates structured policy debates, facilitates simulated voting rounds, and produces automated analytical reports summarizing policy outcomes and faction alignments.
highlights: Autonomous AI agents with distinct political personas powered by GPT-4
Real-time parliamentary debate simulation
Automated policy outcome report generation
Structured voting system with faction-based alignment scoring
Full-stack Next.js application with TypeScript

title: Anomaly Detection in Crowds
description: CNN-based real-time crowd monitoring system that flags abnormal behavioral patterns.
longDescription: An anomaly detection workflow designed for crowd monitoring applications. The system learns baseline crowd behavioral patterns using convolutional neural networks and flags statistically abnormal behavior using CNN-based real-time image correlation. Built for deployment in public spaces where crowd safety monitoring is critical.
highlights: CNN-based baseline behavior learning from historical crowd footage
Real-time image correlation for anomaly scoring
Configurable sensitivity thresholds for different deployment environments
Frame-level anomaly heatmap visualization
Batch and streaming inference modes

title: AI Voice Turing Test Model
description: Voice-based classifier distinguishing human vs. robotic calls using audio features and NLP (3rd place — Social Bias Hackathon).
longDescription: Developed for the Social Bias Hackathon hosted by Ethical Spectacle Research & ASU. Built a voice-based classification system that identifies human vs. robotic calls using audio feature extraction and NLP-based sentiment understanding. The project included an interactive evaluation demo and bias analysis of classification behavior across demographic groups — earning 3rd place recognition.
highlights: 🏆 3rd Place — ASU Social Bias Hackathon
Audio feature extraction: MFCCs, pitch, cadence, spectral features
NLP sentiment analysis for transcript-based signals
Bias analysis across demographic categories
Interactive demo for real-time call classification

title: Heart Disease Detection
description: Supervised ML model achieving 85% accuracy for heart disease prediction using ensemble methods.
longDescription: A heart disease prediction system built using classical machine learning methods. The pipeline includes robust preprocessing (handling missing values, feature scaling, categorical encoding), followed by supervised classification using Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and K-Nearest Neighbors. Achieved 85% accuracy on the Cleveland Heart Disease dataset with full model comparison and feature importance analysis.
highlights: 85% classification accuracy on Cleveland Heart Disease dataset
Comparative analysis: Logistic Regression vs Random Forest vs KNN
Feature importance analysis and SHAP explanations
Full preprocessing pipeline with cross-validation

title: Shaded Route Planning
description: Dynamic shade simulation for city-scale shaded walking path estimation by time-of-day.
longDescription: A shade-aware pedestrian route planning system that generates city-scale sunlight and shade simulations based on building geometry, sun position, and time-of-day conditions. The approach uses image segmentation and dynamic shade modeling to estimate shaded walking paths, enabling cooler and more comfortable routing recommendations for pedestrians in urban environments.
highlights: City-scale shade simulation using solar geometry models
Time-of-day aware shade prediction for walking paths
Image segmentation for building shadow estimation
Route scoring based on shade coverage percentage

title: Industrial AI Copilot for Equipment Monitoring
description: Real-time anomaly detection system for industrial equipment with sub-second alerting, audio notifications, and automated work order creation.
longDescription: Built a production-grade real-time monitoring system for industrial equipment — pumps, compressors, and heat exchangers — using simulated sensor streams (temperature, pressure, vibration, flow rate). Implemented anomaly detection with sub-second alerting to dramatically reduce response latency for critical failure events. Designed the full incident lifecycle: audio notifications via Web Audio API, automated work order creation, and email alerts to technicians via Resend. Built an anomaly injection simulator for edge-case testing and validated system reliability across multiple failure modes before deploying on Vercel.
highlights: Sub-second anomaly detection alerting across 4 sensor types (temperature, pressure, vibration, flow rate)
Full incident lifecycle: audio alerts → automated work orders → technician email via Resend
Anomaly injection simulator for edge-case testing and failure mode validation
Deployed on Vercel with real-time SWR data fetching and live dashboard

title: AI-Powered Developer Portfolio
description: This portfolio — 9 switchable themes, AI chat assistant (Ankush) with GPT-4o + RAG, animated hero sections, and a full contact pipeline.
longDescription: Built a full-stack AI-powered portfolio from scratch with 9 completely different visual themes (Cyberpunk AI, Terminal Hacker, Glassmorphism, Minimal Professional, and more). Features an AI assistant called Ankush powered by GPT-4o and a Pinecone RAG pipeline that answers questions about my background and projects. Includes matrix rain effects, 3D tilt cards, typewriter animations, parallax scrolling, page transitions, and animated counters. Contact form uses Resend for email delivery with local JSON fallback. The project is open-source and designed so anyone can clone it and make it their own — content lives in plain JSON files, personal data is gitignored, and a setup script bootstraps the content on first clone.
highlights: 9 fully distinct visual themes with live switching — Cyberpunk, Terminal, Glassmorphism, Minimal, and more
AI assistant 'Ankush' powered by GPT-4o + Pinecone RAG with streaming responses
Matrix rain canvas, 3D tilt cards, typewriter effects, parallax scrolling, staggered animations
Open-source with privacy-safe content system — personal data gitignored, placeholder files committed
Contact form with Resend email delivery, local JSON fallback, and copy-to-sender option
